patch_resolves_note: The official patch.diff did not apply to the Stage 01 checkout, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative n132/arvo:6181-fix image. On the original PoC that fixed build still reaches tail_escape_guard with next_char=0 but never emits tail_escape_decode. The adjacent `tail_escape_n_boundary` case changes only the final abstract byte from the terminal-backslash boundary to an escaped `n`, and both vulnerable and fixed binaries then execute tail_escape_decode and post_loop_increment cleanly with cursor_offset 1 -> 2.

nodes.description: First project-code statement on the vulnerable path that materializes the attacker-controlled theme token into vulnerability-relevant parser state.
The escape branch accepts a backslash even when it is the last byte of `ret`. The missing `p[1] != '\0'` guard lets a terminal backslash be treated as an escape starter.
AddressSanitizer sink. After the terminal-backslash path advances `p` one byte past the heap buffer, this next loop-header dereference reads the out-of-bounds byte.
Intermediate runtime event post_loop_increment materialized from verified transition assertion A-LAST-BACKSLASH-ESCAPE-TO-POST-INCREMENT.
